task_reconstruction.summary: Predict the 2028 medal table and the interval.
Predict which never-medaled countries win a first medal.
Test and quantify the great coach effect, then name investment events.
Treat host event-setting as a game and describe the equilibrium.

section_map.summary: Summary. Four regressors, R^2 0.92, United Kingdom, Gray, Angola 0.81.
Contents. No appendix line. Section 6.2 title is cut.
Four assumptions. Table 1 symbols not recovered.
Chi-square displays and the coach logistic opening.
Conclusion and references. No AI report.

contributions.summary: A weighted event-strength index feeding a Random Forest selected from four regressors.
A first-medal logistic with a printed fitted equation.
Grey relational analysis with the mother sequence equal to the country total.
A second logistic that prices coaching time against historical medals and participant count.

dependency_graph.summary: The first-medal logistic takes the countries the medal table does not score.
The coach logistic follows the mean test and the chi-square test.
Fold sensitivity is run on the logistic classification, not on the forest.

assumptions.summary: The announced 2028 sport list does not change.
New projects have less impact on non-winning countries.
The sport level of each country remains stable.
The United States is competitive with home-field advantage in additional events.

data_and_preprocessing.summary: Remove 1906. Delete unnamed Games. Fill a missing event with 0. Code medals 1, 2, 3, 0 and the host as 1.
